title: VietAIDetector: An Open-Source Zero-Shot Detector for Vietnamese AI-Generated Text
abstract: arXiv:2608.25478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, distinguishing between AI-generated text and human-written text has remained a challenge. In this paper, we introduce VietAIDetector, an open-source tool designed specifically for detecting Vietnamese AI-generated text. It allows users to interact through a Gradio web interface with inputs ranging from raw Vietnamese text to common text file formats, including scanned documents and exceptionally long texts that exceed the context size of the employed Large Language Models (LLMs). The core component of the tool employs a Zero-Shot approach to detect AI-generated text without requiring domain-specific training data, building upon the previous VietBinoculars and Binoculars research. The tool is built upon a Vietnamese-specific language model and has been evaluated on out-of-domain datasets, demonstrating superior performance compared to existing methods primarily developed for English. translated_title: VietAIDetector：一个用于越南语AI生成文本检测的开源零样本检测器
translated_abstract: 近年来，区分AI生成文本与人类撰写的文本一直是一个挑战。在本文中，我们介绍了VietAIDetector，一个专门用于检测越南语AI生成文本的开源工具。它允许用户通过Gradio网页界面进行交互，输入范围从原始越南语文本到常见的文本文件格式，包括扫描文档和超出所采用大型语言模型上下文大小的超长文本。该工具的核心组件采用零样本方法检测AI生成文本，无需领域特定的训练数据，建立在先前的VietBinoculars和Binoculars研究基础上。该工具基于一个专门针对越南语的语言模型构建，并在跨领域数据集上进行了评估，显示出优于主要面向英语开发的现有方法的性能。此外，用户可以选择最优设置。
tldr: 该论文介绍了一个开源的零样本检测器VietAIDetector，专门用于检测越南语AI生成文本，通过利用越南语特定语言模型和零样本方法，在跨领域数据上表现优于英语为主的现有工具。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces VietAIDetector, an open-source zero-shot detector for Vietnamese AI-generated text, leveraging a Vietnamese-specific language model to outperform English-centric methods on out-of-domain datasets.
